rubric.label: Autonomous drafting
rubric.desc: Can it respond end to end, in context, with minimal human writing?

rubric.label: Content governance
rubric.desc: Does it detect conflicting or stale content and stay synced to sources?

rubric.label: Workflow & collaboration
rubric.desc: Assignments, review cycles, SME chasing, tracking.

T1.label: Bench-tested
T1.desc: We ran the tool through our standard bench. Screenshots, timings, transcript on file.

T2.label: Verified buyer
T2.desc: Named customer, work-email or contract verified, interview on file.

T3.label: Third party
T3.desc: Gartner / G2 / Capterra aggregate, SOC 2 report, public filing.

T4.label: Vendor claim
T4.desc: Docs, pricing page, demo or RFI response. Archived at capture.

T5.label: Inferred
T5.desc: Reasoned from indirect signal. Never load-bearing on a headline number.
